subject.title: session.reset: support mode: "never" for manual-only session reset behavior

question: Should OpenClaw add a public manual-only reset mode now, and if so should the canonical literal be `never`, `off`, or `manual` with `atHour` and `idleMinutes` rejected or ignored?
rationale: This adds public configuration surface in a session-state area, and the repository policy treats config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions even when the code change is small.

options.title: Approve `mode: "never"`
options.body: Add a strict manual-only reset mode that disables daily and idle freshness checks while leaving explicit `/new` and `/reset` behavior intact.

options.title: Use existing `off` vocabulary
options.body: Add `mode: "off"` instead to match other OpenClaw mode switches, accepting that this issue's requested literal changes.

options.title: Defer to broader reset UX work
options.body: Leave this issue open until warning, restore, default reset, and discoverability decisions are settled with the broader session-reset cluster.

recommendation.title: Approve `mode: "never"`
recommendation.body: Add a strict manual-only reset mode that disables daily and idle freshness checks while leaving explicit `/new` and `/reset` behavior intact.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session reset and docs history makes this the best available routing candidate for the product/config choice.
